detail: term sheet declares barrier_level_pct absent; booking has 70

triage.desk_query: Term sheet G10 contains no knock-in barrier clause — no percentage of initial level is stated anywhere in the document — yet the booking record carries barrier_level_pct = 70. Please confirm whether this note is in fact barriered at 70% of initial and the term sheet is missing or superseded by a later version/supplement containing that clause, or whether the note has no knock-in feature and the booking field was populated in error. If a barrier applies, provide the executed document and section reference stating the 70% level and the observation basis (continuous vs. final-valuation-date observation).
triage.rationale: A specific, non-default 70% value in the booking is unlikely to be invented, so the more probable cause is that the term sheet on file is incomplete or an outdated version lacking the barrier clause.
